answers.core: It seems that it's core already. According to @lawnjelly , ResourceLoader::import() is used by the lightmap baker.
answers.workaround:
The only workaround is to unfocus the editor and refocus it. Constantly. Otherwise, there is no automatable workaround in my case.

First I wondered where to even trigger the import, so I noticed the presence of the `resource_saved(res)` signal in `EditorPlugin`. Unfortunately, that signal only fires when the user saves a resource from the inspector, and not when a resource is saved when the user saves the scene (is that a bug? That behavior feels unfinished). So I thought doing it right inside my saving routine would be the correct place to do that.

Then I looked for functions to actually trigger import, by searching "import" in the engine docs... but could not find anything that does what I want.

The Sketchfab plugin also has a similar need, which was worked around using some undocumented metadata stunt to trigger a scan on the whole project:
https://github.com/sketchfab/godot-plugin/blob/379ad4da6e3f9297ff82efec64fe148a2e2f1017/addons/sketchfab/ModelDialog.gd#L188-L193
However, this will still not work for me because that process is asynchronous, and as said above, the game could be starting already while such scan (and the imports that actually *follow* it) would not be complete. Not mentionning it also looks super slow compared to my needs.

title: Import newly generated resources manually or before the game starts
